p.TEST-STATUS: This is a test procedure, not a receipt. Record each executed platform and command independently. No live authentication, model execution, deployment or native Windows success is claimed here.

procedure.title: Offline launcher contract
procedure.p: Use a fake Codex executable in an isolated temporary fixture. Assert exact argv/environment/cwd and real child exit for login, status, interactive, exec and stdin. Check missing/relative home rejection, absent executable, inherited auth/session cleanup with CA preservation, default/override requests, file credential storage, quiet exec suppression and read-only review.

Assert caller home/environment remain intact. Verify no daemon or retry and no credential contents appear in output. Test conflicting quiet/sandbox options fail closed or remain protected according to the executable contract. Fake children prove launch mechanics only.

procedure.title: Installed host profile
procedure.p: In an isolated consumer, install and deploy the resolved package using the explicit host profile. Verify receipt ownership, expected launcher files, executable mode where applicable, collision/drift behavior and undeploy. Do not infer Windows verification from POSIX or PowerShell static parsing.

procedure.title: Optional authorized live probe
procedure.p: Only with live-run authorization, login into a separate explicit absolute worker home. Commission one nonce-bound read-only quiet packet in a minimal cwd containing a sentinel automatic boot document. Require the worker to read only named inputs and answer the nonce-bound question. Record exact process exit and independent model/effort/thread metadata where available; mark missing metadata unverified. A self-report does not prove boot suppression or model identity. Parent examines actual events/artifacts and accepts separately.

Use a nonconflicting conditional prompt: obey any automatically loaded project instruction specifying the final token; otherwise return the quiet token. Pair the quiet run with one enabled-loading control in the same temporary directory and isolated account, using the installed CLI directly with project_doc_max_bytes greater than the sentinel file size. The control must return the AGENTS.md sentinel; the quiet run must return the other token. Both runs are read-only, forbid tools and retain their real exits and JSONL event counts. This is a targeted control for the loading mechanism, not a guarantee against a worker explicitly reading an unnamed file.

Preserve artifacts on failure. An observation timeout requires checking the original handle, not a new launch. No account files or token values become package evidence. Native collaboration boot suppression is a separate host experiment and is never established by this CLI probe.
